tasks.task: Reconcile a bank, card or loan account to its statement

items.when: When you have a statement and a ledger or feed export for one or more months
When you want matched items, near matches and a list of what is left over
When gaps remain, to sort them by type and get a next step for each
When one difference will not clear, to trace it to the entries on both sides
When the owner also wants statements built once the bank agrees to the books
When the totals nearly agree, to work back from the closing balance and check a second way

tasks.task: Sort bank and card lines into the chart of accounts

items.when: When an export needs every line coded, with a confidence note and reusable rules
When lines also need a department and a tax treatment beside the category
When one payee shows under many spellings and rules keep missing it
After coding, to flag lines that look odd for their category, with a reason each

tasks.task: Sort a month of card spending and receipts

items.when: When a card export and a pile of receipts need sorting, with missing receipts listed
When you have the files, to get a categorised file, receipt gaps and a tie-out summary
When small monthly charges pile up, to find forgotten and doubled subscriptions
When the owner never keeps receipts, to shrink the habit to one small monthly step

tasks.task: Build an expense report for one trip or project

items.when: When you have receipts and notes and need totals by category with a reason per line
When expenses are rebilled to clients, to set entry rules, approvals and the handoff
When the report must tie back to the card statement line by line

tasks.task: Reconcile online sales to payouts and bank deposits

items.when: When sales on a platform do not equal what reached the bank for the period
When you can read the store's payouts, to match each to the orders that funded it
When you have two exports and a shared key, to list unmatched rows and duplicate keys
When one payout is off, to trace the difference to fees, refunds or timing

tasks.task: Run the month-end close

items.when: Monthly, once the last bank and card statements for the month arrive
When the close drags, to get a day by day schedule and what is blocking
When the owner wants draft statements and a written reason for each line that moved
When costs belong to the month but the bills are not in, to draft accruals with support
When the client is a freelancer, to sort the month and set the tax share aside
Before you call the month closed, to review what does not reconcile and odd entries

tasks.task: Plan a catch-up when the books are months behind

items.when: When nothing has been touched for months and a deadline is coming
When the catch-up starts, to reconcile each account month by month in order
When the deadline is a personal tax return, to list the records to gather first
When you quote how long it will take, to correct the guess by how such jobs really went

tasks.task: Produce a clean profit and loss for the period

items.when: When the books are reconciled and you need statements with big swings flagged
When the owner wants the month set against last month and what to fix first
When the seller needs true unit costs and margin, not only totals
When each line that moved past a limit needs a written reason
When the statement lives in a spreadsheet, to find formula errors and totals that do not tie

tasks.task: Design a chart of accounts that fits the business

items.when: When a new or messy business needs a small, clear list of accounts with use notes
When the client sells online, to see the profit view the accounts must be able to feed
When the chart is drafted, to test it on a real month and see which lines have no home

tasks.task: Set up accounting software and bank rules

items.when: When the software is new and the accounts and tracking categories must go in first
When regular payees need rules so the feed codes them the same way each time
When the owner has not picked software, to score the options against their needs
When moving from a spreadsheet or old system, to plan field maps, checks and a way back

tasks.task: Build the year-end records pack for the accountant

items.when: When the financial year ends or the accountant asks for records
When you want one tidy pack with totals that tie to the bank and the papers needed
When the client is a sole trader, to list records, totals and questions for the return
When equipment was bought or sold in the year, to list what to capitalise
When a balance must be shown from opening to closing with each movement tied to the ledger

tasks.task: Prepare questions for the owner and the accountant

items.when: When open items from the pack must become a short list of questions
When one tax decision is open, to set out the facts, options and questions for the tax adviser
When you want the odd lines found before the accountant finds them

tasks.task: Summarise payments to contractors for the accountant

items.when: Near year-end, to list who was paid for services, how much, how, and what is missing
When one contractor appears under several names and totals are split
When the roster and invoices are kept monthly, to see whose details or terms need fixing

tasks.task: Set aside money for tax through the year

items.when: When tax bills keep arriving as a shock and the accountant has given a rate
When you want a rule for each payment in, a place to keep it and dates to check
When the plan is set, to check cash still covers bills at 30, 60 and 90 days

tasks.task: Review platform fees, returns and refunds

items.when: When fees and refunds must be split out of each payout before they are judged
When the owner asks what is left per order after cost, shipping, fees and refunds
Monthly, to see which products drive refunds, what returns cost and the first fix
When refunds look high, to find orders with many partial refunds

tasks.task: Write the monthly sales summary for the books

items.when: When the summary must show gross sales, fees, refunds and net deposits that tie to the bank
When dated records need a monthly workbook with counts and totals you can trace
When the summary needs tax collected by state, province and rate for filing prep

tasks.task: Draft journals for accruals, assets and stock

items.when: When a transaction needs a balanced entry with debits, credits and support notes
When several accruals are due, to list each with its support and entry
When purchases may be assets, to decide what to capitalise and the yearly depreciation
When closing stock must be valued from purchases and counts, with write-downs flagged
Before the entries go to the accountant, to review them against the bank and ledger

tasks.task: Find duplicates, odd amounts and missing entries

items.when: When you have the ledger and payment reports, to flag mismatches and missing receipts
When the year has thousands of lines, to flag the odd ones with a reason for each
When records do not add up and you need the money traced and red flags listed
When a number looks fine at a glance, to read the books closely and trace where each cost goes

tasks.task: Set a weekly and monthly books routine for the owner

items.when: When the routine must feed a close that starts in the first week of each month
When the routine needs written steps, who does each and what to do with the odd cases
When the books pass to a part-time bookkeeper who was not there when they were set up
When the owner skips the routine, to tie it to a fixed cue and make the first step tiny

tasks.task: Plan how to track profit by service, site or project

items.when: When the owner wants profit split by service, site or project, to set tracking categories
When the business sells hours, to turn paid hours into revenue and delivery margin
When the business sells products, to check the split shows true unit cost and margin

tasks.task: Check payroll inputs and post the entries

items.when: Before the cut-off, to get an exception list and questions for whoever runs payroll
When pay runs from timesheets, to total hours by person and flag every oddity
When the payroll report must be posted as wages, taxes and amounts owed

tasks.task: Get sales tax figures ready for filing

items.when: When a filing period is due and you need tax collected by place and rate
When the figures look wrong, to check the store's tax settings and rates
When purchases need a tax treatment on each line before the return

tasks.task: Record supplier bills and track unpaid invoices

items.when: When a stack of bills must be read, coded and matched for entry
When bills are entered, to match them and list amounts that need a second look
When open invoices should be reviewed each week with a reminder for each

tasks.task: Write the owner's monthly numbers note

items.when: When this month and last are in, to give a reason for every line that moved
When there is a budget, to say what moved against it and why in a short note
When the owner's real question is whether cash will last the next quarter

always.when: Before any workbook goes to the owner or accountant, to find broken formulas and wrong totals
Before you hand over any period, to flag lines that look out of place

helpers.when: When unpaid invoices need chasing or supplier bills need a proper check and payment run
When payroll itself is wrong or needs setting up, not only posting
When the owner wants budgets, cost reports or accruals that need an accountant's judgment
When the books show a cash or funding problem that needs a plan
When exports need heavy cleaning or a workbook must be built to do the matching
When payout gaps point to a pricing, fee or returns problem in the store

gaps: No library item designs a chart of accounts or tracking categories; only the kit skill does
No library item writes bank feed rules or a set-up checklist for Xero, QuickBooks or similar software
No library item plans a catch-up when the books are months behind
No library item reconciles Stripe, PayPal, Square, Amazon or Etsy payouts; the library covers one store's payouts only
No library item summarises contractor payments for year-end reporting
No library item builds a year-end records pack for a small company; the library only has a personal tax return checklist
No library item prepares a VAT or GST return from the books
No library item matches receipts to bank lines or reads receipt photos into a list
No library item splits personal from business spending in a mixed account
No library item splits loan repayments into interest and capital or records owner drawings
No library item enters opening balances when a business moves from a spreadsheet to software
No library item handles books kept in more than one currency
